Wikipedia (Foot_Locker): brand dates to September 12, 1974; HQ 112 West 34th Street, Manhattan; Dick's Sporting Goods announced the $2.4 billion acquisition in May 2025 and completed it in September 2025; 2,523 stores (2023), mostly in malls in the US, Canada, Europe and Asia; sells 'footwear, sportswear, urban youth apparel and accessories'; nearly 70% of products from Nike.
